underlying_goal: Migrate a Java-based Elasticsearch custom Korean morphological analyzer (analysis-danuri) to Kotlin, with thorough analysis, expert review, and bug-free conversion of all 67 source files
friction_detail: Three critical bugs were initially missed during migration (missing override keyword, copyTo bug, SynonymFilter issue) and required post-review fixes; also significant overhead managing idle team members sending redundant status confirmations.
brief_summary: User asked to migrate 67 Java files of a Korean morphological analyzer plugin to Kotlin using a multi-agent team workflow, and the migration was fully completed after catching and fixing 3 critical bugs in final review.
